definitions.explanation: The fleshy part of the face below the eyes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{涙|なみだ}→なみだ：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{頬|ほお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}った→つたう：noentry⟧。
{頬|ほお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{赤|あか}らめた→あからめる：noentry⟧。
⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→あかちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{頬|ほお}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ふっくら→ふっくら：noentry⟧⟦している→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{子|こ}ども→こども：00554_kodomo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{頬|ほお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{膨|ふく}らませて→ふくらます：09646_fukuramasu⟧⟦{怒|おこ}っている→おこる：00876_okoru⟧。
examples.english: The child is puffing out their cheeks in anger.
examples.notes: {頬|ほお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{膨|ふく}らませる→ふくらます：09646_fukuramasu⟧ = to puff out one's cheeks (sulking/pouting)

examples.japanese: ⟦{冷|つめ}たい→つめたい：00681_tsumetai⟧⟦{風|かぜ}→かぜ：00641_kaze⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{頬|ほお}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たって→あたる：01860_ataru⟧、⟦{思|おも}わず→おもわず：02549_omowazu⟧⟦{目|め}→め：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|と}じた→とじる：02303_tojiru⟧。
examples.english: The cold wind hit my cheeks and I instinctively closed my eyes.

notes:
Can be read as either ほお or ほほ, with ほお being more common in modern usage.

ALTERNATIVE READING:
- {頬|ほお} - more common
- {頬|ほほ} - also used

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {頬|ほお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{染|そ}める→そめる：04253_someru⟧ (to blush)
- {頬|ほお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{赤|あか}らめる→あからめる：noentry⟧ (to turn red in the face)
- {頬|ほお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{膨|ふく}らませる→ふくらます：09646_fukuramasu⟧ (to puff out one's cheeks - sulking)
- ⟦{頬骨|ほおぼね}→ほほぼね：24060_hohobone⟧ (cheekbone)
- ⟦{頬|ほお}{紅|べに}→ほほべに：27322_hohobeni⟧ (blush, rouge)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {頬|ほお}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→おちる：01242_ochiru⟧ (so delicious one's cheeks might fall off)
- {頬|ほお}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つねる→つねる：05348_tsuneru⟧ (to pinch one's cheek - to check if dreaming)
